title: Remembering Matti Caspi: Eretz Tropit Yafa
description: A tribute to Matti Caspi, one of Israel's greatest musicians, through his 1978 album Eretz Tropit Yafa, which brought the songs and sound of Brazil to Israeli listeners.
author: Nir Hasson
intro: Last week we learned of the death of Matti Caspi, one of the greatest musicians and songwriters this country has known. With every record he made sure to challenge himself and his listeners, to explore new styles and to follow his own truth rather than what radio wanted. He is responsible for some of the greatest songs ever made here, made wonderful children's albums, and was behind the flowering of Latin and Brazilian music in Israel. Beyond all that, he was always fascinating to listen to: smart, witty and true to himself.

albums.label: NMC
text: One of my favorite Matti Caspi albums, and to me one of the most beautiful albums ever made in Israel, is Eretz Tropit Yafa (Beautiful Tropical Land), released in 1978. It introduced Israeli listeners to songs from Brazil and to that special style, whose flavor Caspi went on to carry into the songs he released and produced for himself and for others.
Fourteen songs, opening with the title track sung with Yehudit Ravitz and including "Eize Kaduregel" (What a Football Game). A perfect way to remember him.
